title: Pure Ninja
summary: The modern Ninja deck with its Ninjitsu Art cards and generic staples; the page's Branded and Horus engines are left out, as are Karakuri Ninjas and Penguin Ninja, which belong to other archetypes. Ninja Grandmaster Hanzo searches a Ninjitsu Art card when Normal Summoned and a Ninja when flipped or Special Summoned. Tobari the Sky Ninja summons a Ninja from the hand and Fusion Summons on the opponent's turn. Meizen the Battle Ninja summons a Ninja from the Deck whenever the opponent activates something, and Yaguramaru the Armor Ninja banishes a card. The Ninjas flip monsters face-down and back, and Jioh destroys a card each time one flips. Bat, the Forest Ninja, the newest card, summons itself while Hidden Village of Ninjitsu Arts is in the Field Zone. Its search needs Fairy Tale Prologue: Journey's Dawn, which this list doesn't run.
main: Ninja Grandmaster Hanzo
Starter: searches a Ninjitsu Art when Normal Summoned, a Ninja when flipped or Special Summoned.
Tobari the Sky Ninja
Sends itself to summon a Ninja from the hand; Fusion Summons on their turn.
Kagero the Cannon Ninja
Summons a Ninja face-down from the hand or GY; returns from the GY to bounce a targeting card.
Baku the Beast Ninja
Summons itself when added to the hand; returns a Ninja card from the GY.
Mitsu the Insect Ninja
Summons itself; flips a face-down Ninja to negate a monster effect.
Jioh the Gravity Ninja
Flips two monsters face-down; destroys a card each time a monster flips.
Green Ninja
Summons itself and flips your new monster face-down.
Bat, the Forest Ninja
Newest card: Tuner that summons itself with a Field Spell out.
Hidden Village of Ninjitsu Arts
Field Spell: recovers a Ninja card on each summon; protects the Ninjas.
Ninjitsu Art Notebook of Mystery
Quick-Play: sets a Ninja and a Ninjitsu Art from the Deck or GY.
Ninjitsu Art Tool - Iron Digger
Equip: makes any monster a Ninja; banishes a Ninja to destroy a card.
Ninjitsu Art of Dancing Leaves
Tributes a Ninja or face-down monster to summon a Ninja from the Deck.
Ninjitsu Art of Duplication
Tributes a Ninja to summon Ninjas of up to its Level from the Deck.
extra: Fusion: summons a Ninja from the Deck on their activation; Ninjas attack directly.
Fusion: banishes a Ninja card to banish any card.
Link-2: sets a Ninjitsu Art Spell/Trap from the Deck.
Rank 2 from Mitsu and Green Ninja: forces attacks and negates attackers.
